items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Recommendation: retain the security, release, launch, and implementation gates; approve only the bounded read-only public-surface inspection. Evidence: fleet-doctor is unavailable with no last run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; fleet security sitefacts are unknown across 61 sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are therefore unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. No known exploit or credential exposure is evidenced, but absence of telemetry is not clearance. Exact decision: do not approve public launches, monetization expansion, security-sensitive exposure, credential/configuration changes, dependency additions, deployments, or production implementation this cycle. Permit the specified read-only inspection and ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or security-sensitive exposure. Reassess after dated evidence covers access boundaries, secrets, isolation, TLS, release/deploy controls, dependencies and supply chain, data exposure, incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness.
